source_sha_policy: Production must serve the exact immutable merged source SHA and preserve independently verifiable route, metadata and artifact receipts.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; duplicate URLs collapse at runtime; private, minor, legal, financial and quarantined records are excluded from the public universe.

release_intent: Publish the Tactical Ontology homepage from canonical main while preserving the verified public archive, evidence boundaries, critical routes and mail-related DNS records.
promotion_gate: The release is accepted only when 7ya.io serves build marker 7ya-tactical-ontology-20260717-1 and the critical routes, robots.txt and sitemap.xml pass public verification.
rollback: The prior History Song public artifact and immutable Vercel releases remain available as rollback references.
